name: Training Grounds
slug: Training grounds near the Lost Isles in a mountainous region between three islands.
description: The training grounds are located near the Lost Isles, among a group of mountains between three islands over a large expanse. They are approximately five days of flight from the party's previous exit point near the Whispering Abyss.

log.summary: The training grounds were located near the Lost Isles, in mountains situated between three islands over a large expanse. The party's previous exit point near the Whispering Abyss was approximately five days of flight away.

log.summary: Walker recognizes the cave carvings as the view from the top of the training yard, drawn as if from the old tower at the center of the guild stronghold Elrus and Grixto once shared. That tower is now rubble. The ruins sit on a cliffside above the cavern: an average-sized stronghold whose larger footprints are taken to be dragon housing. A huge stable was built into the cliff and was once joined by a covered walkway; the walkway is gone, leaving tiles and a footprint in the overgrowth. The central tower was about eighty feet across, and its thick walls, about five to six feet tall, are the largest standing remains. The site is mossy and grassy, overtaken by vines, bushes, and trees. About eighty feet up, at the old tower height, is the vantage used to compare the landscape with the carved cardinal landmarks.
